timing_verdict.label: BAD
timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: BAD timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: ~1,500 KRW/USD

WHY: The won is currently weak (high KRW per USD at 1,500 midrange), making dollars expensive to purchase. Multiple sources expect the won to strengthen (rate to fall toward 1,450 KRW/USD) in the coming months as Middle East tensions ease and geopolitical risk premiums unwind.

TIP: Consider waiting a few weeks or months if possible, or dollar-cost average your $2,000 monthly buy into smaller weekly/bi-weekly purchases to smooth out the unfavorable current rate.
